note: Corps of Engineers campground beside Gull Dam, at the outlet of Gull Lake on the Gull River near Brainerd: well-spaced wooded sites with long driveways. The swimming beach and boat ramp are across the dam. Water fill and dump at the campground entrance. Enter from the south (the north entrance is closed). --Claude
